mapper.sql: id, family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_until, recovery_exhausted_at, last_failure
mapper.select: SELECT context_version FROM iam_refresh_token_families WHERE id = #{familyId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND (switch_status = 'AWAITING_REFRESH' OR (switch_status = 'PENDING' AND recovery_exhausted_at IS NULL))
SELECT FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND switch_status = 'AWAITING_REFRESH'

SELECT FROM iam_tenant_context_switches WHERE switch_status = 'PENDING' AND recovery_exhausted_at IS NULL AND attempt_count < #{maximumAttempts} AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO iam_tenant_context_switches (family_id, idempotency_key, target_membership_id, target_fingerprint, expected_context_version, switch_status, result_http_status, created_at, completed_at, refreshed_at, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, lease_owner, lease_until, recovery_exhausted_at, last_failure) VALUES (#{row.familyId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.targetMembershipId}, #{row.targetFingerprint}, #{row.expectedContextVersion}, #{row.switchStatus}, #{row.resultHttpStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.completedAt}, #{row.refreshedAt}, #{row.attemptCount}, #{row.nextAttemptAt}, #{row.leaseOwner}, #{row.leaseUntil}, #{row.recoveryExhaustedAt}, #{row.lastFailure}) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE iam_tenant_context_switches SET switch_status = #{switchStatus}, result_http_status = #{resultHttpStatus}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE id = #{workflowId} AND switch_status = 'PENDING' AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount}
